audioandmedia.audregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the audio/media properties record

audioandmedia.auddevref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing DeviceIdentity(DevRegistry), linking these audio/media specs to a device

audioandmedia.sndleveldb.desc: A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring sound output level in decibels from the device

audioandmedia.noiseisodb.desc: A SMALLINT for how many dB of noise isolation the device provides

audioandmedia.wakems.desc: A NUMERIC(5,1) representing how many milliseconds it takes for the device to wake from sleep

deviceidentity.devregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the device identity record

interactionandcontrol.interactregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each interaction/control record

mechanical.mechregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the mechanical properties record

mechanical.swtchcons.desc: A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring the consistency in switch actuation force or performance

mechanical.ghosteff.desc: A NUMERIC(4,1) quantifying the effective impact of ghosting (on a scale or percentage)

mechanical.respointmm.desc: A NUMERIC(3,1) specifying the reset point (in mm) where the switch deactivates on release

mechanical.capmat.desc: A VARCHAR(35) specifying the keycap material (ABS, PBT, etc.)

mechanical.wristflag.desc: A BOOLEAN stating whether a wrist rest is integrated or included

mechanical.palmangle.desc: A SMALLINT measuring the palm rest angle (in degrees), if applicable

mechanical.ergorate.desc: A SMALLINT providing an ergonomic rating (on a defined scale)
